Interval.Name: Measurement interval (seconds)
Interval.Hint: How often each client measures its own latency against the server.

Hide.Name: Hide latency in the player list

Micro.Name: Compact mode (+ / - instead of ms value)

DiagTooltip.Name: Show jitter and estimated loss in tooltip
DiagTooltip.Hint: When disabled, the tooltip only shows the ms value.

AbyssTheme.Name: Abyss Link theme (dark manhwa)
AbyssTheme.Hint: Enables the dark/neon visual layer for Connection Guard badges, banners and panels.

AutoReconnect.Name: More aggressive auto-reconnect
AutoReconnect.Hint: Shortens the delay between reconnection attempts and forces a new attempt as soon as the network or tab become active again.

ReconnectMaxDelay.Name: Max delay between attempts (seconds)
ReconnectMaxDelay.Hint: Ceiling of the exponential reconnection backoff.

HistorySize.Name: How many drops to keep in history

DegradationThreshold.Name: Degradation threshold (ms)
DegradationThreshold.Hint: Average RTT above this value for consecutive cycles triggers a degradation alert.

DegradationCycles.Name: Cycles before degradation alert
DegradationCycles.Hint: How many consecutive cycles above the threshold before triggering an alert.

CustomStun.Name: Custom STUN/TURN servers
CustomStun.Hint: Comma-separated list (e.g. stun:host:port, turn:host:port). Empty uses the default list.

TurnCredentials.Name: TURN credentials
TurnCredentials.Hint: Credentials in user:password format. GM only.

RouteProfiles.Name: Abyss Link — route profiles (JSON)
RouteProfiles.Hint: JSON list of possible routes to the same Foundry server: LAN, Radmin, Cloudflare, playit.gg, direct IP or custom.

RouteScanTimeout.Name: Abyss Link — timeout per attempt (ms)
RouteScanTimeout.Hint: Max time for each route test attempt. Higher values improve tolerance but make scans slower.

GmPanel.Name: Diagnostics Panel (GM)
GmPanel.Label: Open panel
GmPanel.Hint: Latency, jitter, estimated loss, drop history, degradation alerts and route matrix.

WebRtc.Name: Voice/Video Server Advisor
WebRtc.Label: Test servers
WebRtc.Hint: Benchmarks STUN servers and automatically applies the fastest one to WebRTC config.

RouteOracle.Name: Abyss Link — Route Oracle
RouteOracle.Label: Scan routes
RouteOracle.Hint: Compares GM-configured routes and recommends the best path for each player.

Menu.DependenciesNotReady: Connection Guard is not ready yet. Try again after the scene finishes loading.

Badge.NoResponseTitle: No response for several measurement cycles

Banner.Disconnected: Lost connection to the server ({reason}). Trying to reconnect...

Notif.Reconnected: Reconnected to the server (was down for {seconds}s).
Notif.WebRtcAutoFailed: Could not apply automatically. Copy the server manually.

Panel.JournalError: Error creating journal. Check the console.

WebRtc.Explanation: Measuring response time of public STUN servers from your browser. Faster servers here tend to help WebRTC voice/video connect faster and with fewer NAT failures.
WebRtc.HowTo: To use: Configure Game → Audio/Video → Server tab → paste the fastest server URL into the custom STUN/TURN server field.
WebRtc.TurnNote: This only benchmarks STUN servers. Free public TURN servers barely exist; if your table needs one, host your own coturn or pay for a TURN service.
WebRtc.AutoApplied: Best STUN server applied automatically to WebRTC configuration.
WebRtc.CopyFailed: Could not copy automatically — copy the value manually from the table.
WebRtc.NoneAvailable: No server responded in time. Try again.

Route.NoProfilesHelp: Configure profiles in Configure Game → Settings → Connection Guard → Abyss Link — route profiles. Example:
Route.Label: Route
Route.LimitNote: Note: the module measures browser reachability and response time. It does not change VPN, firewall, DNS, OS routing, or force players to switch endpoints.
Route.MatrixEmpty: No player has run the Route Oracle this session.

Hint.MixedContent: The browser may have blocked HTTP from an HTTPS page.
Hint.Timeout: Timed out. The route may be blocked, offline, or unreachable from this client.

Journal.ExportIntro: Entries in memory this session: {count}. Nothing is saved automatically; choose Markdown, JSON, or Journal Entry.
